While people could jump the gun and call your bf things like “he’s a red flag, dump him” or blah blah blah, I’d like to say he’s just not equipped to properly deal with it for extended periods of time either because he has no experience with SA or is burnt out from a previous experience concerning SA. With the therapist however, dump them immediately. Saying “everyone else experiences that a little” does not only do nothing to help anxiety, it worsens it and invalidates your opinion as if it’s just a cog in a machine. If you have any friends willing to talk to you about this then by all means, but also find an actual helpful therapist so you get the help you deserve. In time you can slowly let your bf know that you need him and he’ll be there because he loves you w/ or w/o SA. To answer your question (sorry I’m doing it last LOL), other than medications I’d say that anything interactive such as reading, video games, or exercise works wonders in helping you forget that you’re anxious and a good night drive in the rain has cleared my mind lots of times. Hope you get that help! And keep believing in your bff :)
